description: Extrem-Starkregengefahrenkarte - Wassertiefe NExtrem-200, Saarland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. In the course of the SER-SL project, heavy rain events were simulated with the two-dimensional, hydrodynamic-numerical model HydroAS for the entire Saarland. This dataset shows the maximum water depths simulated by the most extreme precipitation (200 mm) with a distribution according to Euler type II and a load time of one hour. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Extreme heavy rain hazard map - water depth NExtrem-200, Saarland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Saarland, Geowissenschaften, geoportal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
